"Of course - Lok! You're Eathon's boy, aren't you?"
- Clease to Lok Lambert, (The Secret of Two Generations)

"Let's go back to the basics - and the library."
- Clease to Den Fears, (Boys Will Be Seekers)

"These are priceless tomes, not your playthings!"
- Clease to Den Fears, (Boys Will Be Seekers)
